targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -2h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["topic"] == "iiot/group/degiampietro-kern/sensor/humidity")

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -2h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["topic"] == "iiot/group/degiampietro-kern/sensor/temperature")

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> distinct(column: "topic")
  |> keep(columns: ["topic"])
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic !~ /status/)

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -2h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic =~ /sensor\/temperature$/)

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -2h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.topic =~ /sensor\/humidity$/)

from(bucket: "sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "status")
  |> group(columns: ["topic"])
  |> last()
  |> group()  
  |> keep(columns: ["_value", "topic"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
